msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a elegant Spanish woman in her fifties). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia doble-g-barcelona-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): An elegant Spanish woman in her fifties wearing a long burgundy wool coat over a cream blouse and cream trousers from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the Eixample of Barcelona, Spain, with modernist buildings and plane trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia doble-g-barcelona-03.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a camel wool coat over a pink scarf and burgundy wide trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia doble-g-barcelona-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy faux fur jacket with brown wide trousers and a burgundy handbag from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia doble-g-barcelona-15.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a beige and pink checked wool coat over a burgundy top and burgundy trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
